name.pt-BR: Dias de semana do Tempo do Natal

patronOf.en-US: The light of Christmas on ordinary days
patronOf.pt-BR: A luz do Natal nos dias comuns

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Through the tender mercy of our God, the Dawn from on high will visit us.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pela bondade e compaixão de nosso Deus, que sobre nós fará brilhar o Sol nascente.

meta.basis: The weekday Masses of Christmas Time in white (GIRM 346a), painted at sunrise after the Benedictus verse of the chosen formulary, 'the Dawn from on high will visit us'; the crib is kept small so the card stays apart from `christmas_sunday`.

sources.title: GIRM ch. 6, no. 346 (colours: violet in Advent and Lent, rose on Gaudete and Laetare, white at Christmas, green in Ordinary Time)
GIRM ch. 5, nos. 299, 305, 313 (altar, flowers, organ in Advent and Lent)
Directory on Popular Piety and the Liturgy (2001), nos. 98 (Advent wreath), 104 (crib)
